    Class TpCheckers

    The custom <tp-checkers> element displays international draughts positions and plays out endgames.

    Example

    <tp-checkers position="W:W32,34,K46:B17,19,K5" draggable-pieces=""></tp-checkers>

    Tagname

    tp-checkers

    Attr

    position = "W:W31-50:B1-20" - Draughts FEN: side to move and numbered white/black piece lists. Prefix kings with K; ranges are accepted.

    Attr

    fen = "W:W31-50:B1-20" - Alias of position, synchronized after moves. Takes precedence on initial connection.

    Attr

    orientation = "white" - Side displayed at the bottom of the 10 by 10 board.

    Attr

    draggable-pieces = false - Enables human moves by dragging, clicking or keyboard.

    Attr

    draggablepieces = false - HTML-normalized alias of the JavaScript property draggablePieces. tp-checkers-change Emitted after loading, playing or navigating a position.

    Eventdetail

    tp-checkers-change { fen: string; position: string } tp-checkers-move Emitted after a complete legal turn, including all captures and any promotion.

    Eventdetail

    tp-checkers-move { from: string; to: string; path: string[]; captures: { square: string; color: string; type: string }[]; promotion: boolean; fen: string } tp-checkers-end Emitted when a played move ends the game by a win or draw.

    Eventdetail

    tp-checkers-end { fen: string; result: string } tp-checkers-error Emitted for invalid positions or play parameters; the previous game remains unchanged.

    Eventdetail

    tp-checkers-error { message: string }

    Keyboard

    Arrow keys Move focus between playable squares in the displayed direction.

    Keyboard

    Enter / Space Select a piece or play a complete move to a highlighted destination.

    Keyboard

    Escape Cancel selection, dragging or a pending capture-path choice.

    Accessibility

    Numbered square buttons support keyboard play; king icons, captured pieces and live game status have text alternatives.

    See

    tp-chess - Explore chess positions with the same playback controls.
